name: NTT West Kumamoto Data Center
notes: NTT West states its data center service covers all 30 western Japan prefectures; Cloudscene separately identifies an NTT Communications Kumamoto Data Center. Public MW not found.

name: NTT DATA Keihanna OSK11 Data Center
developer: NTT DATA / NTT Global Data Centers
notes: Official NTT DATA opening release says OSK11 is in Kyoto on the Osaka-Kyoto corridor and delivers 30MW of IT capacity.

name: Colt Keihanna Data Centre
notes: Colt DCS facility page states 45MW IT power at Keihanna Science City and notes phase 2 development completion.

name: Ubitus Maizuru City AI Data Center
notes: Ubitus announced a land signing with Maizuru City for a phased AI data center on about 2.3 ha, with construction expected in 2026 and major completion targeted within 2027. MW not disclosed.

name: NTT Docomo Business Kyoto South Data Center
notes: JDCC registry lists Kyoto South Data Center in Kyoto City, opened 2001, tier 2 equivalent. MW not disclosed.

name: Grid Apex Project Mie
notes: Developer page describes a 100MW AI-ready colocation campus in Tsu City, Mie Prefecture, with Chubu Electric power confirmed and target energization in 2028-2029.

name: SuperX AI Mie liquid-cooled pilot data center
developer: SuperX AI Technology with Digital Dynamic, eole, and Woodman
notes: DCD reports SuperX and three Japanese partners plan a 4MW liquid-cooled facility in Mie as a pilot for a potential 300MW campus; exact site not disclosed.

name: ZTV Data Center
notes: JDCC registry lists ZTV Data Center in Tsu City, Mie Prefecture, opened 2008. Public MW not found.

name: Miyagi AI Data Center
notes: Tohoku Electric announced the containerized Miyagi AI Data Center in Shichigahama, Miyagi was completed and would start GPU-server housing service on 2026-07-31. MW not disclosed.

name: NTT East Miyagi Data Centers 1-3
notes: JDCC registry lists Miyagi No.1, No.2, and No.3 data centers operated by NTT East, opened 2002, 2003, and 2013. Public MW not found.

name: Fujitsu Tohoku Data Center
notes: JDCC registry lists Fujitsu's Tohoku Data Center in Sendai, Miyagi, opened 2004 and tier 3 equivalent. MW not disclosed.

name: Miyagi GX Strategic Data Center Cluster Candidate Zone
notes: Reports on METI's 2026 GX Strategic Areas selection identify Miyagi Prefecture as one of nine data center cluster candidate prefectures; municipalities and capacities were not disclosed.

name: Asahi Kasei Networks Nobeoka Data Center
notes: Asahi Kasei Networks operates a data center in Nobeoka, Miyazaki; Cloud Watch states it was established in Nobeoka and began service in 2004. MW not disclosed.

name: JRE Nagano solar-powered data center
notes: DCD reports JRE's 100% onsite solar-powered data center in Nagano Prefecture launched operations in December 2022 and hosts Morgenrot GPU cloud service. MW not disclosed.

name: Tsukaeru.net Nagano Data Center
notes: JDCC registry lists Tsukaeru.net Nagano Data Center in Nagano City, opened 2008 and tier 3 equivalent. MW not disclosed.

notes: JDCC registry lists Densan Data Center in Nagano City, opened 2003 and tier 3 equivalent. MW not disclosed.

name: Fujitsu Nagano Data Center
notes: JDCC registry lists Fujitsu Nagano Data Center in Nagano City, opened 2003 and tier 3 equivalent. MW not disclosed.

name: NTT East Nagano Data Center
notes: JDCC registry lists NTT East Nagano Data Center, opened 2001. MW not disclosed.

name: Nagasaki Regional Data Center Promotion Consortium
notes: Press release announces a consortium intended to build regional data centers in the Nagasaki area using idle facilities such as closed schools or hospitals. Specific site and MW not disclosed.

name: Nagasaki City IX and Data Center Attraction Proposal
developer: Nagasaki City proposal submitter / city consideration
notes: Nagasaki City public proposal page discusses attracting/establishing an IX and data center to improve local routing and support startups. This is an early proposal, not a confirmed facility.

name: SoftBank Nara Ikoma Data Center
notes: SoftBank facility page states Nara Ikoma Data Center has planned total receiving capacity of 50MW and about 40,000 square meters after the second building; IDC Frontier said completion ceremony was held 2025-07-18 and opening was planned for 2025-10; BBIX confirms services inside the facility from 2025-12-22.

name: BBIX Osaka No.9 Center at SoftBank Nara Ikoma Data Center
notes: BBIX opened Osaka No.9 Center inside SoftBank's Nara Ikoma Data Center in Ikoma, Nara Prefecture for IX Connect Service Lite. MW not disclosed for BBIX node.

name: NTT East Niigata Data Center
notes: JDCC registry lists NTT East Niigata Data Center, opened 2002. MW not disclosed.

name: BSN iNet Niigata Data Center
notes: JDCC registry lists BSN iNet's Niigata Data Center in Niigata City, opened 2002 and tier 3 equivalent. MW not disclosed.

name: Rakuten Niigata-Nagaoka Data Center
notes: DataCenterMap lists Rakuten Niigata-Nagaoka in Nagaoka; Kaytus case study references a Niigata containerized data center supporting over 500 servers. Public MW not found.

name: SoftBank Oita Data Center
notes: SoftBank official facility page identifies Oita Data Center and lists power, UPS, cooling, and certifications. JDCC registry lists Oita Data Center in Oita City, opened 2002 and tier 2 equivalent. MW not disclosed.

name: Oita Decentralized Data Center No.1 fund project
developer: CAMEL / local edge data center project sponsor
notes: Crowdfunding page references Oita Prefecture Decentralized Data Center No.1 as an edge data center building project. Details and MW require further confirmation from stronger primary sources.
